Fixed by loading three fresh, independent copies. Not a documentation defect (the existing README prose for edit_cells already says mutations are 'committed', consistent with in-place mutation), but disclosed directly in the documentation-gate.json's own evidence so a future tick's own verification work does not repeat the same mistake.
